answer: The EDPB ChatGPT Taskforce Report states that if ChatGPT is made available to the public, it should be assumed that individuals will input personal data. OpenAI remains responsible for complying with the GDPR and cannot argue that the input of certain personal data was prohibited from the outset. This indicates that OpenAI is accountable for ensuring that any personal data entered by users is handled in accordance with GDPR requirements.
